rowIssues.note: Source prints OEM B3-001-08-025-F0 beside Bolt (M8*20). Both are verbatim; verify the apparent length discrepancy against factory information.
The source uses this exact OEM for RST and FAST quantity 2, and DNM quantity 1. Preserve the fork-specific claims rather than treating them as a universal count.
Printed OEM is exactly 5250-YQ2A-0300. A similar DNM axle in emotobykes is 51250-YQ2A-0300; the missing digit is not automatically corrected and identities are not merged.

notes: 326 legible physical table rows were reconciled, including 38 rows with blank callout cells. This is complete transcription of the visible tables, not proof of a complete stock motorcycle bill of materials.
Six diagram-only callout exceptions need source clarification. Mechanical meaning, year fitment, source typos and variant groupings remain subject to review.
